priorities.action: Define the strategy, universe, holding horizon and numeric risk specification; make a reproducible research acceptance gate the next milestone.
priorities.reason: Inference: missing research criteria are the primary blocker to judging architectural fitness. Require point-in-time data lineage, availability timestamps, corporate actions, historical membership and delistings, feed/adjustment/entitlement records, held-out walk-forward evaluation, a variants ledger, dependence-aware uncertainty and explicit cost/capacity assumptions. Engine execution and paper fills cannot establish strategy validity.

priorities.action: Turn the proposed execution boundary into deterministic, broker-disconnected fault-injection acceptance tests before any separately authorized paper integration.
priorities.reason: Inference: the boundary is a sound proposal but its recovery behavior is unaccepted. Test duplicate intent, timeout after submission, restart, partial fills, stale data, reconciliation before retry, single-writer enforcement, risk-limit breaches, request-budget exhaustion, shutdown and alert delivery. Keep advanced execution disabled; separately accept adapter initialization, exact payload preservation and account-specific provider support. This review authorizes no orders.

priorities.action: Converge on the accepted WSL research path with one workflow owner, one baseline engine and immutable experiment artifacts; gate additions on measured deficiencies.
priorities.reason: Inference: overlapping orchestration and speculative governance services would add ownership and operational burdens before resolving the research gates. Retain LEAN as the baseline; evaluate challengers only against an execution-realism requirement. Avoid overlapping DeerFlow/LangGraph ownership, preserve reviewed memory promotion, and use catalog metadata, source review and native acceptance as distinct evidence levels rather than install criteria.

priorities.action: Separate personal native research acceptance from platform migration, unattended operation and hosted/commercial access; define recovery and retrieval acceptance within each intended scope.
priorities.reason: Inference: successful native login and a manual paired run do not establish that personal coding subscription access covers hosted/commercial product use. Require explicit access terms and runtime acceptance for any such deployment, plus separate macOS acceptance. Before depending on unattended operation, demonstrate off-host restore, key recovery and consumer recovery. Improve retrieval against a representative benchmark; measure complete provider usage before making efficiency claims.

unsupported_claims.claim: The catalog is definitively comprehensive or establishes the highest-quality architecture.
unsupported_claims.reason: Discovery and source reviews remain incomplete, index validation is in progress, and repository counts or stars do not establish suitability. All packet facts are supplied evidence, not independently verified sources.

unsupported_claims.claim: Elite enables 1,000 executed trades per minute, advanced execution is supported, or the architecture is ready for live trading.
unsupported_claims.reason: The supplied rate concerns API requests; actual entitlements are unverified, advanced fields were dropped in an offline serialization probe, and adapter and operational acceptance remain separate. Live trading is outside scope.

unsupported_claims.claim: Successful engine runs establish financial performance, or artifact compression establishes causal provider-token savings.
unsupported_claims.reason: The bundled simulation is engine evidence, paper omits material execution effects, and the reported worker tokens exclude other costs. Neither strategy validation nor a controlled net-savings measurement is supplied.

stopping_assessment: Inference: pause architecture expansion and readiness claims, while continuing bounded offline research and acceptance design. The immediate decision gate is an explicit research/risk specification plus reproducible data and evaluation acceptance. Broker-connected progression additionally requires separately authorized adapter, entitlement and recovery acceptance. Do not wait for exhaustive ecosystem coverage; stop discovery when remaining candidates address no measured gap. No orders, purchases or hosted deployment follow from this review.
